title: Network API — Requests, Errors and Performance
description: Requests, errors and performance of the OAN network APIs.

list.name: period
list.label: Period
list.query: Last 24 hours : 1, Last 7 days : 7, Last 30 days : 30

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') AS api
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'
ORDER BY api

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: All: each request is counted once, at the service that received it first. One service: everything that service received.

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName AS service
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'
ORDER BY service

options.content: Health of the network APIs: **how many requests came in, how many failed, and how fast they were answered.**

panels.title: Request summary
panels.description: Total, successful and failed requests, and the error rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count() AS "Total requests",
  countIf(NOT failed) AS "Successful",
  countIf(failed) AS "Failed",
  round(100 * countIf(failed) / nullIf(count(), 0), 1) AS "Error rate"
FROM (
SELECT
  Timestamp AS ts,
  ServiceName AS service,
  replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') AS api,
  toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) AS status,
  status >= 400 OR StatusCode = 'Error' AS failed,
  StatusMessage AS status_message,
  Duration / 1e6 AS ms,
  SpanAttributes['transaction_id'] AS transaction_id,
  if(SpanAttributes['message_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['message_id'], SpanId) AS request,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp) = 1 AS is_entry,
  greatest(ms - leadInFrame(ms) OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), 0) AS own_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL ${period} DAY
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND $__conditionalAll(replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') IN ($api), $api)
) WHERE if('${service:raw}' = 'All', is_entry, service = '${service:raw}')

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS "Total",
  countIf(NOT failed) * 60 / $__interval_s AS "Successful",
  countIf(failed) * 60 / $__interval_s AS "Failed"
FROM (
SELECT
  Timestamp AS ts,
  ServiceName AS service,
  replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') AS api,
  toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) AS status,
  status >= 400 OR StatusCode = 'Error' AS failed,
  StatusMessage AS status_message,
  Duration / 1e6 AS ms,
  SpanAttributes['transaction_id'] AS transaction_id,
  if(SpanAttributes['message_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['message_id'], SpanId) AS request,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp) = 1 AS is_entry,
  greatest(ms - leadInFrame(ms) OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), 0) AS own_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND $__conditionalAll(replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') IN ($api), $api)
) WHERE if('${service:raw}' = 'All', is_entry, service = '${service:raw}')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time WITH FILL FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) TO $__toTime STEP $__interval_s

options.content: **Performance** is how long a request takes to get its answer (response time). **p90**: 90% of requests were faster than this. **p95**: 95% were faster. **p99**: 99% were faster; only the slowest 1% took longer.

panels.title: Within target time
panels.description: Percentage of requests answered within the target time: 0.5 s for discover, 2 s for publish, 1 s for other APIs.

panels.title: Response time (p90, p95, p99)
panels.description: Lines close together mean consistent response time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  toNullable(quantile(0.9)(ms)) AS "p90",
  toNullable(quantile(0.95)(ms)) AS "p95",
  toNullable(quantile(0.99)(ms)) AS "p99"
FROM (
SELECT
  Timestamp AS ts,
  ServiceName AS service,
  replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') AS api,
  toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) AS status,
  status >= 400 OR StatusCode = 'Error' AS failed,
  StatusMessage AS status_message,
  Duration / 1e6 AS ms,
  SpanAttributes['transaction_id'] AS transaction_id,
  if(SpanAttributes['message_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['message_id'], SpanId) AS request,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp) = 1 AS is_entry,
  greatest(ms - leadInFrame(ms) OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), 0) AS own_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND $__conditionalAll(replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') IN ($api), $api)
) WHERE if('${service:raw}' = 'All', is_entry, service = '${service:raw}')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Requests by API
panels.description: Performance is OK when p95 is within the target time, Slow above it, and Very slow above twice the target.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  api AS "API",
  count() AS "Requests",
  countIf(NOT failed) AS "Successful",
  countIf(failed) AS "Failed",
  round(100 * countIf(failed) / count(), 1) AS "Error rate",
  round(quantile(0.9)(ms), 1) AS "p90",
  round(quantile(0.95)(ms), 1) AS "p95",
  round(quantile(0.99)(ms), 1) AS "p99",
  multiIf("p95" > 2 * transform(api, ['discover', 'publish'], [500, 2000], 1000), 'Very slow', "p95" > transform(api, ['discover', 'publish'], [500, 2000], 1000), 'Slow', 'OK') AS "Performance"
FROM (
SELECT
  Timestamp AS ts,
  ServiceName AS service,
  replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') AS api,
  toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) AS status,
  status >= 400 OR StatusCode = 'Error' AS failed,
  StatusMessage AS status_message,
  Duration / 1e6 AS ms,
  SpanAttributes['transaction_id'] AS transaction_id,
  if(SpanAttributes['message_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['message_id'], SpanId) AS request,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp) = 1 AS is_entry,
  greatest(ms - leadInFrame(ms) OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), 0) AS own_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND $__conditionalAll(replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') IN ($api), $api)
) WHERE if('${service:raw}' = 'All', is_entry, service = '${service:raw}')
GROUP BY api
ORDER BY "Requests" DESC

panels.title: Top errors
panels.description: The most common errors, with the number of requests each one affected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  if(e.code != '', e.code, concat('HTTP ', toString(f.status))) AS "Error",
  if(e.message != '', e.message, f.status_message) AS "Message",
  f.api AS "API",
  f.failed_at AS "Rejected by",
  count() AS "Requests"
FROM (
SELECT r.ts AS ts, r.service AS service, r.api AS api, r.status AS status, r.ms AS ms,
       r.transaction_id AS transaction_id, r.request AS request,
       r.status_message AS status_message, d.failed_at AS failed_at
FROM (
SELECT
  Timestamp AS ts,
  ServiceName AS service,
  replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') AS api,
  toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) AS status,
  status >= 400 OR StatusCode = 'Error' AS failed,
  StatusMessage AS status_message,
  Duration / 1e6 AS ms,
  SpanAttributes['transaction_id'] AS transaction_id,
  if(SpanAttributes['message_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['message_id'], SpanId) AS request,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp) = 1 AS is_entry,
  greatest(ms - leadInFrame(ms) OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), 0) AS own_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND $__conditionalAll(replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') IN ($api), $api)
) AS r
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT request, api, argMax(service, ts) AS failed_at
  FROM (
SELECT
  Timestamp AS ts,
  ServiceName AS service,
  replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') AS api,
  toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) AS status,
  status >= 400 OR StatusCode = 'Error' AS failed,
  StatusMessage AS status_message,
  Duration / 1e6 AS ms,
  SpanAttributes['transaction_id'] AS transaction_id,
  if(SpanAttributes['message_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['message_id'], SpanId) AS request,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp) = 1 AS is_entry,
  greatest(ms - leadInFrame(ms) OVER (PARTITION BY request, api ORDER BY Timestamp ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING), 0) AS own_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND $__conditionalAll(replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') IN ($api), $api)
)
  WHERE failed
  GROUP BY request, api
) AS d ON d.request = r.request AND d.api = r.api
WHERE r.failed AND if('${service:raw}' = 'All', r.is_entry, r.service = '${service:raw}')
) AS f
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT service, request, any(c) AS code, any(m) AS message
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName AS service, LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
         JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['message'], 'error', 'code') AS c,
         JSONExtractString(LogAttributes['message'], 'error', 'message') AS m
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ServiceName, JSONExtractString(Body, 'message_id'),
         JSONExtractString(Body, 'error_code'), JSONExtractString(Body, 'error')
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'error_code') != ''
)
WHERE c != '' AND request != ''
GROUP BY service, request
) AS e ON e.service = f.service AND e.request = f.request
GROUP BY "Error", "Message", "API", "Rejected by"
ORDER BY "Requests" DESC
LIMIT 20
